GUARANTY

This Guaranty is made as of January 20, 2026 by Rosalind Achterberg, an individual residing in Evanston, Illinois (the "Guarantor"), in favor of Ironwood Equipment Finance LLC, an Illinois limited liability company (the "Lender").

1. Obligations Guaranteed. Guarantor absolutely and unconditionally guarantees to Lender the full and prompt payment and performance when due of all obligations of Achterberg Fabrication Inc. (the "Borrower") under the Master Equipment Financing Agreement between Borrower and Lender dated January 20, 2026, together with all interest, fees, and costs of collection (the "Guaranteed Obligations").

2. Nature of Guaranty. This is a guaranty of payment and not of collection. Lender may proceed against Guarantor without first proceeding against Borrower, any collateral, or any other guarantor, and without pursuing any other remedy.

3. Continuing Guaranty. This Guaranty is continuing and remains in effect until the Guaranteed Obligations are paid in full. It is not discharged by any partial payment.

4. Waivers. Guarantor waives presentment, demand, protest, notice of acceptance, notice of default, and all other notices. Guarantor waives any right to require Lender to marshal assets. Guarantor waives any defense arising from the incapacity or dissolution of Borrower.

5. Amendments to the Guaranteed Obligations. Lender may amend, extend, renew, or restructure the Guaranteed Obligations, and may release collateral or any other guarantor, without notice to Guarantor and without releasing Guarantor. Guarantor's liability is not affected by any such change.

6. Subordination. Any indebtedness of Borrower to Guarantor is subordinated to the Guaranteed Obligations. Guarantor shall not seek reimbursement, contribution, or subrogation from Borrower until the Guaranteed Obligations are paid in full.

7. Maximum Liability. Guarantor's aggregate liability under this Guaranty shall not exceed $750,000 plus accrued interest and costs of enforcement.

8. Governing Law and Venue. This Guaranty is governed by the laws of the State of Illinois. Guarantor consents to the exclusive jurisdiction of the state and federal courts sitting in Cook County, Illinois.

9. Costs of Enforcement. Guarantor shall pay Lender's reasonable attorneys' fees and costs incurred in enforcing this Guaranty.

10. Entire Agreement; Amendment. This Guaranty is the entire agreement of Guarantor with respect to the Guaranteed Obligations and may be amended only by a writing signed by Guarantor and Lender.

GUARANTOR:
/s/ Rosalind Achterberg
Rosalind Achterberg
